name: SaunaLife CL4G | 3-Person Outdoor Cube Sauna Kit
description: Description The SaunaLife CL4G is a 3-person outdoor cube sauna kit handcrafted in Northern Europe. Its full-length panoramic bronze glass front sets it apart from every barrel and cabin sauna in this price range — natural light fills the interior, and you get a clear view of your backyard while you sweat. Inside, the contoured knotless Thermo-Aspen bench and arched backrest are shaped for long sessions, and with over 6'2" of ceiling height, even tall bathers can sit upright on the upper bench without ducking. The CL4G also comes with something most sauna kits in this price range don't: a permanent asphalt shingle roof, front and back floor drains, a full ventilation system, and a premium LED lighting kit with Wi-Fi app control — all included, not sold as extras. Features Spacious design with over 6’2” of interior height comfortably accommodates up to 3 bathers Contoured Thermo-Aspen bench and arched backrest for superior ergonomic support Tempered bronze-tinted full-glass front wall for a bright, airy ambiance and outdoor views 1.7-inch Thermo-Spruce exterior — thermally modified for natural resistance to decay, pests, and weather without chemical treatments Shapely Scandinavian design that enhances both function and curb appeal Shingled roof and drip rails for excellent water management and long-term durability Premium dotless white LED light system with Wi-Fi app control and wireless remote Designed by SaunaLife and handcrafted in Northern Europe for premium craftsmanship Low-voltage (24V DC) lighting system rated for water and heat safety Expandable lighting system supports up to four LED sources Compatible with 6–8 kW electric sauna heaters — heater and stones sold separately so you can choose based on your preferences Full ventilation system with vents in the back creating a natural chimney effect for consistent, even heating DIY-friendly assembly designed for 1–2 people — detailed installation manual included What's Included? Model CL4G Outdoor Home Sauna Kit Walls of Thermo-Spruce (42mm) Front and back wall of Thermo-Spruce (28mm) Tempered bronze front glass wall (8mm) Ergonomic sauna bench of Thermo-Aspen Ergonomic backrest of Thermo-Aspen Ventilation system Fascia boards Foundation beams Montage kit Front details painted black Installation instructions White LED Light System with Wi-Fi App 2 white LED lights Wi-Fi, app-based operation Wireless handheld remote and mounting cradle 90W power supply and driver 30’ light cable (IP67-rated) 3 articulating mounting clips 3 flush mounting clips Installation instructions for lighting system Specifications Model: CL4G Wall and Ceiling Material: Thermo-Spruce Bench and Backrest Material: Knotless Thermo-Aspen Interior Dimensions: 77.2"W x 41.3"D x 74.8"H Exterior Dimensions: 80.7"W x 49.2"D x 82.7"H Door Dimensions: 23.2" x 66.5" Door Handle: Square, Wood Material Glass Style: Tempered Bronze (8mm thick) Shipping Dimensions: 80"W x 44"D x 41"H (203 x 112 x 104 cm) Shipping Weight: 1415 lbs Back Wall and Lower Bench Dimensions: Back Wall - 76", Lower Bench - 49.8" Bench Depth: Top - 17.7", Lower - 8.3" Staves Thickness: 1.7" Assembly & Installation The CL4G ships flat-packed on a pallet and is designed for DIY assembly. SaunaLife includes a detailed step-by-step installation manual with the kit. What to expect: - 1–2 people can handle the full build - Plan for a weekend project — most assemblies take 6–10 hours depending on experience - Basic tools required (drill, level, rubber mallet — no specialized equipment) - The sauna kit includes all necessary montage hardware, foundation beams, and fascia boards Electrical requirements: You'll need a dedicated 240V circuit for your sauna heater. The exact requirements depend on the heater you choose. you'll also need a 120V line for the lights of the sauna. Foundation: The CL4G needs a flat, level surface. Concrete pad, paver stones, or a reinforced deck all work. SaunaLife lists the CL4G at 1,415 lbs (before the heater and stones), so make sure your surface can support it.
